title: 第1310章 我不信命第1309章 唯有复仇
content_zh:
第1310章我不信命
陈平夺取了他太多东西，一次又一次地抢他的机缘、坏他的计划、把他逼到绝路。
这份仇，他记在心里，刻在骨头上。
他要夺回属于自己的东西，特别是祖龙气运。
只要杀了陈平，夺了祖龙气运，他就是最后的胜利者。
韩道人收回思绪，手指在地面上又刻下一个节点，阵图又完善了一部分。
就在这时，密室外传来了脚步声。
脚步声在密室外停下，然后响起一个低沉的声音。
"大人。"
韩道人头也不抬，手指继续在地面上刻画阵图，嘴里吐出一个字。
"进。"
密室的石门推开，一个人走了进来。
这人身材瘦小，穿着一身暗灰色的长袍，脸上布满了细密的皱纹，颧骨很高，眼窝深陷，嘴唇很薄，看起来像一具裹着人皮的骷髅。
他走到韩道人面前，单膝跪下，动作干脆，膝盖撞在兽皮上发出沉闷的声响。
这个人是绝命九老中排名第九的九元老，也是韩道人最信任的心腹。
九元老是韩道人一手扶持起来的。
他的资质很差，靠正常修炼，这辈子连金丹中期都很难达到。
但他运气好，遇到了韩道人。
韩道人祭献了不少东西，炼制了血丹，然后用血丹，强行帮他突破了境界。
血丹的药效猛烈，服用之后经脉被撑裂了三次，丹田差点炸开，浑身骨头都碎了一遍。

但挺过来之后，他突破了金丹中期，又突破到了金丹后期，最后依靠更加强大的血丹，突破到了元婴境界。
正常的元婴修士是靠积累和感悟突破的，他不是。
他是被血丹堆上去的。
他的元婴境界比任何人都虚浮，战力在元婴修士中垫底，但他不在乎。
原本的人生上限是金丹中期，现在能踏入元婴境界，多活千年，比什么都值。
所以他对韩道人忠心耿耿，比狗还要听话，比狗还要忠诚。
"禀告大人。"
九元老低着头，声音压得很低。
"陷阱已经布置完成，情报也已经释放出去了。所有环节都按照大人您的吩咐安排好了，人手全部就位，只等目标入阵。至于那人是否会上钩，只能听天由命。"
韩道人停下刻画阵图的手指，缓缓抬起头来。
他的眼睛很亮，眼白里布满了血丝，瞳仁中倒映着密室墙壁上阵纹的暗红色光芒。
盯着九元老看了几息时间，然后笑了。
"不。"
韩道人的声音很轻，语气却笃定。
"他会上钩的。准确地说，这不是上钩，是他一定会来。"
content_en:
Chapter 1310 I don’t believe in fate
Chen Ping took too many things from him, robbed him of opportunities, ruined his plans, and pushed him to a dead end again and again.
He kept this hatred in his heart and engraved it on his bones.
He wants to take back what belongs to him, especially the Ancestral Dragon's luck.
As long as he kills Chen Ping and takes away the fortune of Zulong, he will be the final winner.
Han Daoren retracted his thoughts and carved another node on the ground with his fingers, completing another part of the formation diagram.
At this moment, footsteps came from outside the secret room.
The footsteps stopped outside the secret room, and then a deep voice sounded.
"My lord."
Without raising his head, Taoist Han continued to trace the formation pattern on the ground with his fingers and uttered a word.
"Come in."
The stone door of the secret room opened and a man walked in.
This man was thin and wearing a dark gray robe. His face was covered with fine wrinkles, his cheekbones were very high, his eye sockets were sunken, and his lips were thin. He looked like a skeleton wrapped in human skin.
He walked up to Taoist Han, knelt down on one knee, and made a dull sound when his knee hit the animal skin.
This person is the ninth-ranked Nine Elders among the Nine Elders of Jueming, and is also the most trusted confidant of Han Taoist.
Mr. Jiuyuan was supported by Taoist Han.
His qualifications are very poor. With normal cultivation, it will be difficult for him to reach the middle stage of Jindan in this life.
But he was lucky enough to meet Taoist Han.
Taoist Han sacrificed a lot of things to refine the blood elixir, and then used the blood elixir to help him break through the realm.
The effect of the Blood Pill was so strong that after taking it, the meridians were torn three times, the Dantian almost exploded, and all the bones in the body were broken.
But after surviving it, he broke through to the middle stage of the golden elixir, then to the late stage of the golden elixir, and finally relied on the more powerful blood elixir to break through to the Nascent Soul realm.
Normal Nascent Soul monks rely on accumulation and perception to achieve breakthroughs, but this is not the case for him.
He was piled on top of the blood elixir.
His Yuanying realm is more illusory than anyone else's, and his combat power is at the bottom among Yuanying monks, but he doesn't care.
The original upper limit of life was the middle stage of the Golden Core. Now that I can step into the Nascent Soul realm and live for another thousand years, it is worth more than anything else.
Therefore, he is loyal to Taoist Han, more obedient than a dog, and more loyal than a dog.
"Report to your lord."
The ninth elder lowered his head and kept his voice low.
"The trap has been laid out and the information has been released. All links have been arranged according to your instructions, sir. All manpower is in place, just waiting for the target to enter the formation. As for whether that person will take the bait, we can only leave it to fate."
Taoist Han stopped carving the formation with his fingers and slowly raised his head.
His eyes were bright, the whites of his eyes were bloodshot, and his pupils reflected the dark red light of the formations on the walls of the secret room.
He stared at the Nine Elders for a few breaths, and then smiled.
"No."
Daoren Han's voice was very soft, but his tone was firm.
"He will take the bait. To be precise, this is not about taking the bait, but that he will definitely come."
